title: Odile and the Portrait
author: Vesper Marchetti
blurb: Freya Galloway, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
